title: Single-Family Homes and Toronto’s New Global Role
summary:
Throughout October UrbanToronto is featuring a special State of Housing 2026 editorial series to examine the pressing housing challenges facing Toronto and the Greater Golden Horseshoe.

* * *

An argument can be made that no type of structure is more important to the history, society, and overall urban fabric of Toronto than the detached single-family home. From the historical charm of ones in the Annex or Cabbagetown to the more modern forms in Scarborough or Etobicoke that have become homes for the city’s diverse immigrant population, single-family homes have become the defining feature of Toronto’s built environment.
